name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST Withdrawn & Never Approved (2627 AY), then POST a New Course (2728 AY)
description: Variant of apprenticeship-draft-post-progression-2728: POSTs a draft apprenticeship for the 2627 academic year that is already withdrawn at POST time (withdrawalDate set) and is never approved via ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent. Then SLD POSTs the same learner onto a different, unrelated course starting in the 2728 academic year — exploring how the draft-POST/Progression path behaves when a learner's only prior record is an unapproved, withdrawn draft. Exploratory — no assertions yet.
